name: 系统边界与拓扑隔离

question.instructions: Evaluate compliance with System Boundaries: client SDK zero heavy server container dependencies, strict unidirectional dependencies.

criteria.passed: Clean dependency hierarchy. Pure client SDK/driver has zero heavy server container libraries (Spring, Netty, Jackson, HikariCP), modules follow strict unidirectional flow.
criteria.violated: Violates boundary: heavy server container dependencies leaking into client SDK, or circular module dependencies.

why: 核心正交架构红线：客户端驱动严禁引入服务端重型容器依赖，模块依赖保持严格单向且职责边界自闭环。
